entities.summary: Kristján Jónsson was Denmark's Minister for Iceland from 14 March 1911 to 24 July 1912 and a member of the cabinet of Danish Prime Minister Klaus Berntsen. He was a member of Althingi 1893 to 1905 and from 1908 to 1913.

entities.summary: Kristján Jónsson was Denmark's Minister for Iceland from 14 March 1911 to 24 July 1912 and a member of the cabinet of Danish Prime Minister Klaus Berntsen. He was a member of Althingi 1893 to 1905 and from 1908 to 1913.
